skill.name: subagent-driven-development
skill.description: Coordinate sequential coding tasks through fresh subagents, explicit Git SHA tracking, and two review gates for specification fit and code quality.
skill.summary: Run multi-task development plans with isolated subagents and diff-based review gates.

content.value_statement: Complex implementation plans lose quality when tasks share stale context or skip review. This skill structures each task with fresh subagents, SHA tracking, and two review passes.
actual_capabilities: Breaks a multi-task plan into sequential implementation cycles.
Defines required BASE_SHA and HEAD_SHA tracking for every task.
Provides implementer, specification reviewer, and quality reviewer prompt templates.
Requires tests, lint, type checks, and exact command reporting when applicable.
Uses diff-based reviews to compare each task against its specific scope.
limitations: Requires a separate plan from another planning workflow.
Assumes Git is available for SHA tracking and diff review.
Depends on the host environment supporting subagent dispatch.
Does not implement code by itself without an implementation task.

use_cases.title: Execute a Feature Plan
use_cases.description: Run a multi-step feature plan one task at a time with implementation, spec review, and quality review.

use_cases.title: Control Agent Scope
use_cases.description: Keep each agent focused on one task and one diff so unrelated refactors are easier to catch.

use_cases.title: Audit AI Coding Work
use_cases.description: Require command logs, test summaries, changed files, and reviewer notes before moving to the next task.

prompt_templates.title: Run One Planned Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a single task from an existing plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven development for task 1 from my plan. Track BASE_SHA, dispatch an implementer, then run spec and quality review before marking it complete.

prompt_templates.title: Execute a Full Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for a sequential multi-task implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this implementation plan once, extract every task, capture the starting BASE_SHA, and execute each task with fresh subagents and two review gates.

prompt_templates.title: Recover After Review Issues
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow when a reviewer finds missing requirements or quality problems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the current subagent-driven workflow from the failed review. Send the issues back to the implementer, update HEAD_SHA after fixes, and rerun the relevant reviewer.

prompt_templates.title: Run Final Diff Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow after all tasks are complete.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform the final review across the first BASE_SHA and final HEAD_SHA. Confirm all tasks are complete, check cross-task issues, and prepare the branch for finishing.

output_examples.input: Execute a five-task feature plan with subagent-driven development.
output_examples.output: The assistant tracks each task, records base and head revisions, runs implementation, performs spec review, performs quality review, and only then proceeds.

output_examples.input: The spec reviewer found an extra feature in task 2.
output_examples.output: The assistant routes the issue back to the implementer, requests a fix or plan amendment, updates the task revision, and repeats spec review.

output_examples.input: All tasks are complete and need final validation.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the full implementation range, checks for cross-task issues, confirms test evidence, and hands off to branch completion.

best_practices: Provide the full task text to each subagent instead of making it reread the plan.
Require exact commands, test results, changed files, and SHA values in every implementer report.
Keep reviewers focused on the task diff instead of the entire repository.
anti_patterns: Do not run multiple implementers in the same working tree.
Do not accept review reports that lack file and line references for issues.
Do not continue to the next task while spec or quality issues remain unresolved.

faq.question: What does this skill help automate?
faq.answer: It helps coordinate implementation tasks, review gates, and Git revision tracking for AI-assisted software development.

faq.question: Does it replace a planning skill?
faq.answer: No. It expects an existing implementation plan and focuses on executing that plan safely.

faq.question: Why use fresh subagents for each task?
faq.answer: Fresh subagents reduce context pollution and make each task easier to review against its own requirements.

faq.question: Why are BASE_SHA and HEAD_SHA required?
faq.answer: They give reviewers a precise diff range, which limits review scope and improves accountability.

faq.question: Can this run tasks in parallel?
faq.answer: Not in one working tree. The skill is designed for sequential execution unless separate branches or worktrees are used.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
